entry_state: Appendix A closes the proposed operation and record reference. Reports preserve branch and period meaning; storage changes preserve provenance; EPS records retain ordered dilution, exact context and partial outcomes. Appendix B now supplies the teaching grammar, core records and execution rules.
exit_state: Appendix B preserves the teaching grammar while distinguishing syntax, record shape and financial semantics. Unknowns remain symbolic; universal answers require the full feasible scope; rule selection and event publication have explicit failure behavior. The conditional example and conformance map lead to the research-source qualifications in Appendix C.
findings: Historical teaching records do not silently expand the newer portable interface or confer posting authority.
The typing rule preserves currency and separately requires observation context compatibility.
Feasibility precedes universal query interpretation; partial search cannot establish a whole-family conclusion.
The override relation selects maximal rules with explicit unsupported and conflict results. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
